title: Are you in a Masquerade? Exploring the Behavior and Impact of Large Language Model Driven Social Bots in Online Social Networks

bias_targets.methodology: Scoring the toxicity of generated tweets from LLM-driven social bots using the Perspective API and the COLD model, and qualitatively categorizing instances of highly toxic content to identify identity-based hate behavior, such as white supremacy and racist remarks.

Scoring the toxicity of generated tweets from LLM-driven social bots using the Perspective API and the COLD model, and qualitatively categorizing instances of highly toxic content to identify identity-based hate behavior, such as anti-Semitism.

Measuring and comparing the content similarity of historical tweets generated by LLM-driven bots across different languages (e.g., English vs. Chinese) using cosine similarity on text embeddings to identify language-based performance variations.
